faqs.question: How do I book a photography studio session in Cainta?
faqs.answer: Browse the Studio Directory, select your favorite Cainta accredited studio, choose your desired service and time slot, and confirm your reservation with a 30% GCash or cash downpayment.

faqs.question: Can I pay via GCash QR Ph in real time?
faqs.answer: Yes! When selecting GCash at checkout, a dynamic QR Ph code is generated instantly. Once scanned using your GCash app, our system confirms your reservation in real-time via payment push notifications.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation and rescheduling policy?
faqs.answer: You may reschedule up to 48 hours before your booking date without penalty. Cancellations within 24 hours are subject to studio terms.

faqs.question: How do photo proofing and print store orders work?
faqs.answer: After your session, the studio uploads watermarked previews to your Photo Proofing tab. You star your favorite images, write retouch notes, and can also order acrylic or canvas prints directly.
